verdict.rationale: Appwrite's Databases product docs describe managed databases with structured/relational data, typed columns, relationships, indexes, and permissions, plus a separate dedicated Postgres option — accessible via client and server SDKs as implied throughout the docs and CLI/resource management references. Community feedback corroborates it as a practical BaaS choice with working self-hosted and managed options. missing for 10: no explicit code snippet or independent hands-on test showing both client and server SDK read/write flows against the managed database.
